width.description: Column width in pixels. Ignored when widthChars is set.

widthChars.description: Column width in characters, measured at the column's own font and size. Overrides width. Prefer this: a pixel width means a different number of visible characters at every body text size.

header.description: This column's header, overriding the list-wide header style. A header shows a fixed label, so it resolves no expression and carries no click action beyond the sort toggle.

text.description: Shown instead of the column name. The name stays the sort key either way.

textAlign.description: Horizontal alignment of the header label within the column.

color.description: RGB colour array [r,g,b] or [r,g,b,a]. Overrides the sorted-column highlight for this header.

backgroundColor.description: RGB colour array [r,g,b] or [r,g,b,a] painted behind the header label.

fontSize.description: Overrides the list style headerTextSize for this column.

fontWeight.description: bold or light; anything else renders normal.

fontFamily.description: Overrides the list face for this header.

itemName.description: The name of the item to be displayed.

truncate.description: An array of two numbers representing the start and end index of the substring to be displayed.

format.description: Transition-altitude presentation for this item. "altitude" uses the system's altitudeFormat and picks the band from the item's own value; "flightLevel" always uses the above-transition band, for values that are always a level. An object overrides the system default inline. Explicit truncate, padWithZeroLeft, prefix or suffix on this item override the matching part.

placeholder.description: A placeholder string to be displayed when the item is empty or equal to 0.

prefix.description: A prefix string to be displayed before the item, it can also be an expression rule.

suffix.description: A suffix string to be displayed after the item, it can also be an expression rule.

mapping.description: A mapping object to map item values to display values, this forces the display value based on the item value you set.

padWithZeroLeft.description: A number to pad the item value with leading zeros.

padWithZeroRight.description: A number to pad the item value with trailing zeros.

fontSize.description: Font size of the itemm can also be an expression rule.

fontWeight.description: Font weight of the item, can also be an expression rule.

textAlign.description: Text alignment of the item, can be left, center or right.

lineHeight.description: Line height of the item, can also be an expression rule.

anyOf.description: RGB color array [r,g,b]
RGBA color array [r,g,b,a]
RGBA color array [r,g,b,a] or [r,g,b] (0-255, and 0-1 for a)

color.description: Color of the item (in RGBA), can also be an expression rule.

blinkColor.description: Blink color of the item (in RGBA), can also be an expression rule.

backgroundColor.description: Background color of the item (in RGBA), can also be an expression rule.

separatorBefore.description: Whether add a blank padding the item.

showPlusMinus.description: Whether to show a plus/minus sign before the item if the item is a number.

value.description: A static value or expression to be displayed instead of the item if the item name is set to text.

leftClick.description: The action to be performed when the item is left-clicked

rightClick.description: The action to be performed when the item is right-clicked

doubleClick.description: The action to be performed when the item is double-clicked, on a radar label as well as in a list.

middleClick.description: The action to be performed when the item is middle-clicked.

leftDrag.description: Radar-label only: dragging from a tag item starts a drawing tool. A list column has nothing to drag from, so this does nothing here.

textWeight.description: Fine stroke weight. Negative thins the strokes, positive thickens them, 0 is the font's own weight. Overrides fontWeight.

textSharpness.description: Edge hardness. 0 keeps the rasteriser's own antialiasing, 1 gives a near-binary edge. A negative textWeight with some sharpness gives a thin, crisp look.

fontFamily.description: Font family for this list's column headers and cells. Bundled with the client: "Roboto Mono" (the default when this is absent), "Cascadia Mono", "Inter". A column whose tagItem sets its own style.fontFamily wins over this for that column. An unknown name falls back to Roboto Mono.

paddingLeft.description: Inset in DIP between the list frame and the first column. Without it a left-aligned first column sits against the border. The header bar and each row highlight still span the full frame; only their content moves in, and the window widens to keep every column visible.

paddingRight.description: Inset in DIP between the last column and the list frame. Separate from paddingLeft because the first and last columns usually carry opposite text alignments, so the optical gap they need is not the same.

altitudeFormat.description: How altitude-valued tag items render either side of the transition altitude. Declared once per system; items opt in with "format".

prefix.description: Text placed before the digits, e.g. "A" below the transition altitude.

suffix.description: Text placed after the digits, e.g. "00" to render full feet rather than hundreds.

digits.description: MINIMUM digit count of the value in hundreds of feet, zero-padded and never truncated. 2 renders 3000 as "30" and still renders 12000 as "120".
